notes.title: Catching Up! - July 2025 Status Update
notes.notes:
Hey, Duelists!

Yesterday, our brand-new guest fighter Globule was finally released into the world! We're super happy to finally have her out for everyone to play, but we're also sure many of you have questions for us. It's been 7 months since Master Locks released, and new characters don't normally take us nearly that long. So why the heck did this one? We wanna take some time to catch you all up on where we've been, what's happened behind the scenes, and of course, give you some more insight into our latest crossover.

[hr][/hr]
Duels of Fortune × Decline's Drops: Globule Joins the Fight!

Yep, in case you somehow haven't heard yet, our newest fighter is Globule, the protagonist of the punchy action-platformer Decline's Drops!!

[previewyoutube=8LZ4EH4YoaY;full][/previewyoutube]
We designed every aspect of Globule to feel like she was plucked straight out of her home game, with hard-hitting attacks, tons of movement options, delightfully stretchy animation, and even her own personalized meter system! Decline's Drops is essentially a singleplayer platform fighter, so it was a fun challenge translating her gameplay into a completely different kind of fighting game. She ended up as a highly mobile bruiser who can really put the pressure on her opponents, thanks to her unique meter mechanics and access to invincible dodges she can use to quickly reposition herself at the cost of a small amount of meter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/27bbb292ea240f23b13ee9287b5157337306d8f2.gif

Believe it or not, this collaboration has been planned for years, since long before Decline's Drops was even released! In fact, talks of it date all the way back to 2020 (!!!), so we're beyond excited to be able to finally welcome Globule into Duels of Fortune! Whether you're a fan of Decline's Drops, or just happy that the wait for a new character is over, you can get your gloves on and go play Globule right now, if you haven't already!

Speaking of the wait, though...

[hr][/hr]
Where Have We Been?

Let's take some time to level with you guys a bit. We wanna be as transparent with you all as we can.

After the release of Master Locks, we stepped into 2025 with very high hopes. We knew that we were going to have more time than ever to work on the game this year, and we thought we knew how we were going to spend it. But, you know what they say about the best laid plans, right? Let's talk about what's happened, and why there's been such a long wait between new characters.

First, Ben's knee surgery, which we briefly mentioned in our last status update. First of all, the surgery went well, and he's been making a great recovery! Nothing to worry about there. However, the surgery also impacted Duels of Fortune's development a lot more than we expected. Since we knew that it was upcoming and that there would be a lengthy period afterward where development would be stalled, we didn't want to start any big, important things (like working on Globule) until after the surgery, so that they wouldn't be interrupted. It was a sound idea... while we still thought the surgery was in February. But of course, as our luck would have it, it kept on getting delayed. We were completely in the dark about exactly when it would happen until it finally took place at the start of April. So yeah, there was unfortunately just a long period where we didn't really feel like we could commit to anything important, which is why we instead spent a lot of that time working on the Fractured Fighters mode that was released in April. It was a fun distraction for us, but that's ultimately all it really was.

After that, though, we could actually start on the crossover content. Development on Globule properly began around mid-April, and we've been working on the update ever since. Characters don't normally take us over 3 months to finish, though -- and indeed, Globule has already been feature-complete since June, actually. Drazglb., the lead developer of Decline's Drops, wanted to have Globule's reveal be a part of the Decline's Drops Direct he was holding, and we had no reason not to accept. We knew we would love if something related to our game was became a big announcement for the Decline's Drops community as well! For any of you who may be coming to our game from the DD community because of that: Hello and welcome! Unfortunately, this plan required us to wait all the way until late July to finally release the character, even when she was already done for a while. We can only hope that she's been worth the wait for you guys!

As you can imagine, the long wait for the Decline's Drops Direct means we had a lot of downtime during this update cycle. So alongside the crossover content, we also took the time to tweak and refine a bunch of characters and system mechanics to improve the balance and feel of the game! It was some things we'd been wanting to address for a long time but never had a good opportunity to, like rethinking Callowman's overall design and toning down the maximum length and damage of combos. Overall, we feel the changes have been really healthy, and the flow of matches is better than ever before!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/606f2adefa98e29a24dddfcbc61391304c6a0805.gif

The update also features lots of new costumes, as well as new Missions and stages! It's an update so packed, we had to make a whole overview trailer just to show off everything we made! You can check that trailer out below if you missed it.

[previewyoutube=5ACJO_pzO_4;full][/previewyoutube]
Also, if you want to keep up to date with future announcements, be sure to check out our Bluesky or Twitter (X) account. And if you wanna keep up with development AND hang out with the community, consider joining our official Discord as well!

So yeah, in case you were worried that something serious was going on, we're all good -- we just had several back-to-back cases of unfortunate timing! Now that Globule is released, though, we're hoping to get right back on track and return to our usual character-making schedule!

And on that note, let's take another look at that fighter roadmap!

[hr][/hr]
Future Plans
The Next Fighter

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/c3bc94f1320a1e7c6988e580fb8cc3adfc1282de.png
Next up is a character (or rather, a pair of characters) that has been on the backburner for nearly 5 years now: the cosmic power couple Miko & Mira! These two will feature a setplay-based moveset that highlights their teamwork-oriented fighting style, so we're expecting them to be pretty technical! You'll be frequently calling Mira to attack, so you'll have to manage both Miko's position and the position of the floating star that Mira appears from!

While we don't have much to show for these soulbound lovers, as we haven't made a start on them in-game yet, here's some early concept sketches for some of Miko's attacks! He'll be making good use of his massive signature weapon to boast some serious range!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/7b0a5b63e5cadbfaa442e3a4498157f0d452a879.png
All of this is subject to change, of course, but hopefully this little teaser gets you excited for these two to make their debut! We're certainly very excited to get working on them!

Story Mode
Aside from that, there's the matter of Story Mode. While we don't have much to directly say about it just yet, we just wanted to let you all know that we're still making steady progress on it! We estimate the writing is about 75% done now, and we've also recently begun working on the cutscene system again.

While we're no longer 100% confident that the first handful of chapters will be playable in-game by the end of this year, mainly thanks to the multiple delays we've faced, we're hopeful that at most the wait won't be much longer beyond that! Because trust me, the amount of time it's taken pains the two of us just as much as it probably does you -- if not more!

And that brings us to our last point on future content, and it's perhaps a less happy one...

Scaling Back
Our desire to get Story Mode done and the game into a finished state is stronger than ever before. We want to focus all our energy on the important content from now on, and as a result, we've had to make some unfortunate sacrifices to our existing plans.

Most of the content we're scrapping is stuff that we hadn't revealed publicly anyway. Mainly some stages, bosses, and ideas for new singleplayer content. But, unfortunately, because of this we do have one piece of news that may be disappointing to hear: we have made the decision to delay Punching Bag until post-launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/2307adc0e9cf5e766add13b8913808af85246eb7.gif

We understand this is probably a bit upsetting for some of you, as we know from our popularity poll last year that Punching Bag's playable debut was pretty highly anticipated. But truth be told, we've hit a bit of a roadblock with designing the little guy's moveset, and instead of scratching our heads over it, we'd currently rather put that energy into designing other fighters that are actually important to Story Mode.

Don't worry, this doesn't mean Punching Bag is gone forever! Like I said, he's just been delayed, not cut outright. While we can't promise anything, we can tell you that once the full game is released and Story Mode is complete, we'll do everything in our power to get him into the game in a playable form! Stay strong, Punching Bag fans! Your day will come!

[hr][/hr]
Wrapping Up

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/0a14351f4134bf5fc7fc6e421a29e3c09963b677.gif

With that, we've shared everything we can for now! If Globule looks like a fun character to you, then... well, what are you waiting for?! She's out right now! She's BEEN out, even! Go play her, and show us what kinds of crazy things you can do with her!

Thanks for reading and for being patient with us for all this time. Have a great day, and we'll talk to you again once the next major update is on the horizon! Hopefully it won't take 7 months this time!

- Ben and Kaleb

notes.title: Globule Joins the Fight!! Version 0.11.0 is Live!
notes.notes:
Globule Joins the Fight!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/dd116bdec6ca3b2daca492c786545794cab3c17c.png

Hello, Duelists! It's been a while since our last major update, but we're back, and with a brand-new guest character! Please welcome Globule from Decline's Drops to the roster!

This crossover has been a long time coming, and we couldn't be happier to finally see the puppet in action! Even if you don't know the original game (though you should totally check it out if that's the case), Globule's unique mechanics and playstyle make her a ton of fun on her own merits! We hope you enjoy putting on your oversized blue boxing gloves and smashing your opponents into the ground!

Aside from the Decline's Drops crossover content, we've also made some sweeping changes to the game's systems in this update, especially when it comes to combos. Most notably, Blast Burst has had its ability to reset combos greatly nerfed, leading to fewer situations where one player doesn't get to play for a whole round because they're stuck in a long combo. Here's a quick overview video of all the new things in this update, but if you want specifics, you can read the patch notes below!

[previewyoutube=5ACJO_pzO_4;full][/previewyoutube]
Speaking of which, here are the full patch notes for this update. It's a CHUNKY one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/4511aad036b83bba41fca053396b2abcafc705dc.png

NEW FIGHTER

 Globule from Decline's Drops smashes into the fight! With both powerful attacks and impressive mobility at her disposal, this determined puppet is ready to do whatever it takes for the sake of her garden!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/72722acf000ed0f84a51de29038dcf201fccc853.png

There's a looooong list of system changes here, but we had a few main goals in mind when making them:
[olist]
 Reduce the overall damage potential of longer combos to make touch-of-deaths more difficult
 Make it less effective to use the same moves repeatedly in a combo, without limiting what combos are possible
 Reduce the overwhelming impact that Blast Burst can have on the pace of a match
 Clean up miscellaneous issues and poor/outdated design decisions that have been left in the game for too long[/olist]Though most of these changes are technically nerfs, we've been finding the game a lot more fun and interesting since making them! The game is a bit less centralized around long combos now, which has led to far more back-and-forth matches with a wider variety of gameplay interactions! The changes may take some getting used to, especially for the diehard labbers out there, but we hope you'll come to enjoy them as much as we have!

Damage

 Using the same move multiple times in a combo now incurs a damage penalty on that move -- a system we are calling "stale moves". This penalty becomes stronger the more times an attack is used within the same combo, capping at a 75% damage reduction on the 4th use
 Special moves that are stale will also have their minimum damage scaling brought down to 20%. Super moves currently won't become stale at all
 Blast Burst resets the staleness of all attacks

Super Moves

 Using any Super move now reduces your Super Meter gain by 75% for 4 seconds (the same penalty that using a Reversal incurs)
 Using a Super near the opponent while they are in hitstun no longer adds to their hitstun time

Blast Burst

 Blast Burst now only resets hitstun scaling by 3 steps instead of resetting it completely, greatly reducing the potential length of Blast Burst combos
 Blast Burst now resets damage scaling by only 40%, compared to the previous 60%
 Blast Burst now deals a fixed amount of histun, independent from hitstun scaling. This is to ensure it will always function the same as a combo extender even after the aforementioned nerfs
 Fixed an issue where landing a Blast Burst on an opponent right as they were floor bounced could cause the upward velocity to stack, launching them absurdly high
 Fixed an issue where using a Burst during a time where Blast Burst is unavailable (such as during a Super cinematic) would prevent you from using Burst until the animation of the move ended

Blocking

 The "Block Button" control mode has been removed, with the default "Back-to-Block" now being the only available option. All CPU opponents have also been reprogrammed to use Back-to-Block instead of Button Block
 This decision mainly comes down to the fact that it has become more and more difficult to accommodate the Block Button option as we've continued to balance, design, and bugfix around Back-to-Block primarily. This is especially true of the new character Globule, whose unique dodge mechanics would be largely incompatible with the Block Button mode due to being tied to the same button. Its existence was largely a legacy feature anyway, and from our observations the vast majority of players seem to prefer Back-to-Block. We apologize if you happen to be a rare player who preferred Block Button.

Combo Bounces

 Any move affected by launcher decay that can also cause a wall bounce or floor bounce (such as Clyde's Inferno Upper) will no longer outright lose its ability to cause a bounce after the first use in a combo, instead properly using the "weak" bounce if the bounce has already been consumed
 Fixed an issue where two full wall bounces could occur back-to-back, if the move that caused the second wall bounce was started just before the opponent hit the wall from the first attack

Grabs

 Characters caught in any grab (including command grabs) are now invincible to projectiles, as well as attacks from extra characters such as Chip (Lumina's puppet), until they are thrown. This prevents many different issues in which throws could be interrupted by projectiles, leading to janky results
 Breaking out of a grab now makes both players invincible until the end of the breaking animation, preventing lingering projectiles from giving either player an unfair advantage
 Fixed an issue where certain grabs (such as Shoto’s and Callowman’s) would start damage scaling at 100% instead of 90% when used as a combo starter

Corner

 Tweaked the corner systems to allow you to jump over a cornered opponent if they are walking away from the corner, as previously this interaction produced strange-looking results

Dashes

 Grounded backdashes are now invincible to throws for the first 6 frames of the animation

Loop Prevention

 Fixed an issue where some moves with multiple possible IDs (such as moves with multiple selectable angles/versions) would not properly count towards loop escapes

Projectiles

 Fixed an issue where projectiles would sometimes ignore damage scaling and/or combo starter proration
 Fixed an issue where projectiles could clash with each other during Super cinematics
 Fixed an issue where certain multi-hitting projectiles would progress hitstun decay faster when used multiple times in a combo

Button Remapping

 When you map an action to an input that's already being used by another action, the two mappings will now be properly swapped. Unassigned inputs are finally a thing of the past!
 IMPORTANT NOTE: If you have any unassigned actions in your control settings, you will need to reset them manually. A prompt should appear on the rebinding screen to help you with this

Quick Rematch

 Selecting this option now instantly refills both players' HP, preventing issues where a player could be KO'd after the option was selected

CPU Players

 CPU-controlled characters will now attempt to dodge certain attacks, mainly grabbing attacks, by jumping over them. The chance for them to do this scales with their difficulty level

Music

 Added new music tracks to the Jukebox and stage select:
 One Big Frog -Power Mix- (by ModalModule, arranged by Jack7)
 One Big Frog (Original) (by ModalModule)
 Former Fields -BRK Mix- (by ModalModule)

Miscellaneous

 Updated the action icons throughout the game (i.e. the Light/Medium/Heavy/Special icons)
 Fixed an issue where physics objects dropped by certain characters did not have the correct friction values (such as Johnson's hat and Guy's glasses)
 Updated the smoke particles from when a character is launched
 Characters now properly disappear after their "Star KO" animation, preventing issues where the model would linger in the background of some stages

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/cbb7716b618ef949dac8accd7cb34567d22cb15d.png

All Menus

 Added a brief fade when loading into most menus in the game to help smooth out the transitions between menus

Character Select

 Pressing the "toggle" button before selecting a character (the same button used to change costumes) now lets either player toggle between being a player or a CPU. This prevents Player 2 from being stuck as a CPU if Player 1 selects too fast, and also allows you to do CPU vs CPU matches if you want to
 Selecting Random now also randomizes the costume of the character you get, picked from all costumes you currently have unlocked
 Fixed Master Locks being mistakenly excluded from the random character pool

Stage Select

 The stage select was getting too full, so we've updated it to be able to scroll up and down. We've also taken the time to reorganize the stage select to group stages together more intuitively
 Added an "Auto" option to the stage select. Selecting this option will select a stage and music track to match one of the characters being played, picking randomly between player 1 and 2
 Music selection and Battle Options are now accessed via separate button inputs, rather than having to select them on the stage select grid

Lore Journal

 When viewing a locked costume in the Lore Journal, the costume’s unlock condition will now be shown

Pause Menu

 Fixed an issue where the mouse could be used to interact with checkboxes on certain pause menus despite the mouse not being visible on-screen

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/e493e688709d6351430042a5c8ca79827148f724.png

NEW STAGE: Former Fields

 A vast, colourful hillside, with scenery faithfully recreated from the first level of Decline's Drops! With hazards enabled, you can ring your opponents out off the sides of the stage, and attack poisonous mushrooms to create temporary platforms

NEW STAGE VARIANT: Azu-Corps Holding Cells

 A variant of Azu-Corps Headquarters. The Azu-Corps keep all sorts of dangerous individuals locked up here, including any bosses you've defeated in Mission Mode, who can randomly appear in the cells in the background!

Unknown Plane

 Fixed a lighting issue where certain materials (namely the shiny “slime” material used for Ember) were affected by the stage’s coloured lights much more than other materials

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/981c3af368d00472949c5d9875aca192d4820d44.png

Arcade Mode

 A new theme, "Beach Party", is now available, in which characters will only wear swimsuits or other summer-themed costumes
 Added a new ruleset: Hardcore, a challenging mode which will truly test your skills!
 Your HP now carries over between each round and each fight, with only a small heal after winning a round. Getting a Perfect doubles the amount of health you recover
 Rounds you lose now act as lives, meaning that losing a round against one opponent will count that round as lost for every future opponent as well. And there are no continues here, either! Once you're out, you're out! The “VS” screen now stays up a bit longer, even if loading has finished, to give you more time to process who you’re about to fight if your PC can load quickly
 The loading screen now fades to black when transitioning to the match, making it feel a bit smoother
 The animations that play on the jumbotron between rounds can now be skipped
 Fixed an issue where rival battles would not load costume characters correctly (e.g. Callowman’s rival would always be another Callowman instead of Callowtron)

Mission Mode

notes.title: Fractured Fighters Returns! Version 0.10.4 is Live!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=YMlm4DHxkmY;full][/previewyoutube]
Get ready for crazy antics in the new Fractured Fighters mode, the triumphant return of a cancelled game that nobody asked for (Except Doodle, probably)! With terrible balance, zero quality assurance, and approximately 80% less intentional game design than the base game, you're sure to wish you were playing almost anything else! Or maybe you'll like it, for some reason. Only one way to find out!

April Fools jokes aside, this update isn't just for sick kicks (even if it is mostly that). We've also added a brand-new stage, Silver Stadium Lobby! Fighters from all around the world are gathered here in anticipation of the Duels of Fortune tournament, so you'll be able to spot lots of familiar faces in the background!

Overall, this update includes:

 The new Fractured Fighters gamemode for Arcade Mode (also unlockable for Versus matches!)
 A new Arcade Mode theme, Fractured Fighters, which features only characters who appeared in the cancelled game of the same name (including some unique CPU opponents!)
 A new stage, the Silver Stadium Lobby
 A new Mission
 A metric ton of bug fixes (special thank-you to SynCinn in our Discord for discovering and reporting the vast majority of these!)

And here are the full patch notes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/72722acf000ed0f84a51de29038dcf201fccc853.png

New Ruleset

 Added a new ruleset for Versus mode: Fractured Fighters, which can be enabled in the options menu on the character select screen! This ruleset changes the game to be like a platform fighter, in which you must defeat your opponent by knocking them out of bounds 3 times! The knockback and hitstun of your attacks will also scale with the amount of damage your opponent has taken. Happy (late) April Fools, please enjoy this horribly unbalanced mess we've concocted!
 NOTE: You must first complete a run of Arcade Mode with this ruleset enabled before it can be used in Versus matches

CPU Opponents

 Fixed various issues relating the the CPUs attempting to use moves while getting up from a knockdown

Dashes

 Fixed an issue where characters with run-type dashes could continue holding their dash after the opponent was KO'd, leading to unusual-looking results

 Fixed an issue where, if a Throw Break left either character airborne, both characters would become stuck in permanent hitstun

 Fixed an issue where enabling Button Block would still allow you to block attacks by holding backward, greatly reducing the effectiveness of left-right mixups

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/cbb7716b618ef949dac8accd7cb34567d22cb15d.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/981c3af368d00472949c5d9875aca192d4820d44.png

Arcade Mode

Training Mode

notes.title: Tutorial Mode and More! Version 0.10.3 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey Duelists! Duels of Fortune Version 0.10.3 is out now, with the central new feature being the additional of Tutorial Mode! We know many people have been asking for better learning resources for the game, as many new players seem to misunderstand or outright miss lots of core mechanics, so we hope that this mode will be the perfect solution! We've done our best to make the tutorials in a way that gets all the necessary information across concisely, but effectively, while injecting lots of fun personality into the whole experience.

While only the Basics section of the Tutorial is currently finished in its entirety, we are planning to add more tutorials with each update going forward, so eventually the whole thing will be filled out! If you have any suggestions for mechanics or interactions you'd like to see covered in the Advanced section in the future, let us know, because there's a very high chance that we have not thought of everything!

Regarding the next major update
As most of you already know, the next major thing we will be working on is a new guest fighter! However, some complications have come up. Don't worry, the guest fighter will still happen, it just might take a bit longer than expected. Ben has an upcoming surgery scheduled for sometime within the next few weeks (we don't know when!), and he'll be completely out of commission for more than a week afterward. As such, we don't want to commit to any big projects such as a new guest fighter until the recovery period is over, so that we can have a smoother work flow when the time comes. Once again, the guest fighter WILL happen, we just ask that you be a little patient with us for the next few months.

Happy Holidays, Duelists! It's our final update of the year, and boy have we got a BIG present for you all! In case you somehow missed it, the lovable karate instructor Master Locks has finally made his playable debut, and we couldn't be happier to have him here!

Master Locks is a somewhat unorthodox take on the typical "shoto" archetype, putting his own unique spins on each of his attacks, while also remaining a solid and dependable choice for beginners and experts alike! Moves like his steerable projectile Buzz Cut and his long-ranged trapping move Hair Extension let him play from a distance, while also having powerful mix-ups tools like Hair Flip to go on the offensive! An all-around great moveset for an all-around great guy!

And of course, since we know everyone LOVES to get clothes for Crimbo, this update is also loaded with the most costumes we've ever packed into a single update! Master Locks himself is launching with 3 alternate costumes right out the gate, and we've also made 5 additional costumes for other characters! Shoto, Derrick, Lumina, Guy, and Johnson mains all have something nice to unwrap this year!

As a final message, we wanted to thank each and every one of you for just playing our silly little game, and for supporting it with reviews and by sharing the game with your friends and followers. 2024 has been an amazing year for Duels of Fortune, and that's all thanks to the wonderful community that's managed to grow around it. While we may not have the skills, time, or resources to provide big features like online play or mod support, we appreciate that you guys are largely understanding of that, and that you enjoy what we make regardless. Frankly, that alone means the whole world to us. ❤

We plan to make 2025 the game's biggest and best year yet. Hope you look forward to the future of DoF, and of course, have a happy new year!

notes.title: The Next Fighter: Master Locks! - December 2024 Status Update
notes.notes:
Hey, Duelists!

It's been a while since we've done one of these status updates, but that's mainly because we've been focusing on a lot of more secrety stuff since releasing Lance. Between writing for Story Mode and creating content for the 0.10.0 update, we've been quite busy! But now it's time to show you what this update has in store, starting with the brand-new fighter we've just unveiled...

[hr][/hr]
Stylish Master of Karate and Barbering, Master Locks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/adf5828a932755bdec11bc30fb2ca61caf5c49db.png
That's right! Duels of Fortune's 21st fighter is none other than the fan-favourite karate-instructor-slash-hairstylist, Master Locks, finally making his playable debut!

[previewyoutube=HP3AQpBi2gc;full][/previewyoutube]
Master Locks has a fairly balanced playstyle, though slightly more geared towards offense, using his versatile hair-manipulation Aspect to play neutral from a distance, and his expert martial arts skills to challenge the opponent up close... all with his own signature brand of Locks Dojo stylishness! His moveset features lots of unique twists on familiar concepts, including a projectile that can be steered left and right at will, a leaping attack with multiple possible follow-ups on the way down, a ranged hitgrab that can immobilize the opponent, and even a command grab Super that can reach all the way across the screen! Despite his free-spirited and jovial attitude, Locks isn't playing around -- he's here to demonstrate his absolute mastery of his fighting style!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/74ae4f10b92fdb2404e7aa71d9b5c2aa77c0c613.gif

Locks is likely the single most highly-requested character to join the playable cast, and we couldn't be happier to finally have him there! Truth be told, we've been planning him in secret for some time -- a couple years back, we realized just how much certain parts of the Story Mode would benefit from having him playable. But that's a discussion for later!

We hope you're all excited to school your opponents with Master Locks, when the 0.10.0 update drops on December 29! Now let's get to talking about some of the other additions in the update...

[hr][/hr]
New Costumes!

In case you missed it, we'll be releasing quite a handful of costumes for existing characters in the update, as we tend to do. Let's take a look at them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/6248e3edfcec40f5e5d664b0b6b92856b8207934.png
This time, we're giving some love to several alt costume characters, by giving them costumes of their own! Casual Shin (Shoto), Burglar Roy (Guy), and Pharaoh Rag-Z (Derrick) all bring fresh looks to these beloved second-fiddles. These three costumes will each be unlocked by beating Arcade Mode as the costume character in question.

And last, but not least...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/8b2937e0535d503f958f13e57714bc3f0cba8a41.png
Chef Lumina is cooking up a storm! We've been neglecting to give Lumina as many costumes as we probably should, so hopefully this very silly one will make up for it! Really gives a whole new meaning to "putting them in the blender".

Of course, Master Locks will also be getting some costumes of his own, but we'll reveal those at a later date! Follow us on Bluesky or Twitter, or join our Discord Community to keep up to date on every announcement we make!

This last announcement is regarding a feature that's been asked for a lot, and something we've admittedly been slacking on for far too long...

[hr][/hr]
Tutorial Mode!

Yep, we're finally giving Duels of Fortune a proper in-game tutorial! Not the most exciting announcement, we know, but we do plan to do some very interesting things with it! The tutorial mode will be hosted by none other than the new fighter, Master Locks, who is very excited to teach you all the ins and outs of fighting!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/965fdb2529408c82c3af68f56880820f9ec9bdaf.gif

When going through the tutorials of other fighting games, we personally often find they're either too minimal to give you a solid enough understanding of the mechanics, or so long-winded that the only thing you learn from them is how to fall asleep at your computer. With Duels of Fortune's tutorial, we hope to strike just the right balance on this front, letting you get through things quickly while not spending too long on the nitty-gritty details (at least while you're still learning the ropes).

The tutorial will also be split into three sections: Basic, Advanced, and Character. Basic and Advanced will both focus on game-wide mechanics, where Basic will teach you the fundamentals, and Advanced lets you tackle the more difficult mechanics and learn the intricate details of certain systems. The Character section, on the other hand, is comprised of lessons breaking down each character's moves and unique mechanics -- which will even be narrated by the character themselves! Note that you will have to complete the Basic section before moving on to Advanced or Character tutorials, just to ensure you can understand everything being shown!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/defd4c20caac14bf2de18d38d3fb38f08d5e1689.png
There is one thing to note: THERE IS NO GUARANTEE TUTORIAL MODE WILL BE ADDED IN THE 0.10.0 UPDATE. It's something we've been working on pretty on-and-off, so we currently have no idea if it'll be ready in time for Master Locks' release date. And even if we do finish it in time, it won't release with everything right off the bat -- the Advanced section will be absent, and at most there will only be a few Character tutorials to start off. Advanced and Character lessons are something we plan to add slowly over the course of multiple future updates, until we're fully caught up on everything. Getting the Basic tutorial done and released is our absolute priority.

Regardless, we hope many of our newer or more casual players will appreciate this addition to the game! We want Duels of Fortune to feel inviting and accessible, even to those who have never touched a fighting game before, so this should help bring us a bit closer to that goal!

[hr][/hr]
Our Plans for 2025

2024 has been a great year for Duels of Fortune! This was our first year on Steam, and because of it, the game has reached way more people than we ever thought it would! We've even managed to faintly catch the attention of some pretty notable figures in the fighting game community (BIG shoutouts to those who've been submitting DoF clips to Will It Kill!). Perhaps most importantly, though, is that we managed to hit tons of personal goals for the year! Once Locks is out, we'll have released 4 new characters, all of which are needed for Story Mode! It feels like we've made some real progress!

Speaking of characters, let's take another look at that roadmap to see who you guys can expect to join the roster in 2025!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/ddbc1c9bc7405de588f3cd3efd3d4a86af4c5540.png
The first fighter of the new year will be a brand-new guest fighter! It's been quite a while since Johnson and Ember were first added, so it's about time we introduce a fresh face to the guest character club! Like the previous two, this character will come from a fellow indie game... but of course, our lips are sealed on their exact identity! Who do you think it'll be?

After that, it's the long-awaited Miko Starfinder! Him and his partner Mira were originally part of the closed beta, being first added all the way back in December of 2020, but soon enough this cosmic power couple will be ready to make their proper debut! They'll be followed shortly after by another mystery fighter, and this is one we've been holding onto for even longer than Master Locks!

Beyond that, we're not yet entirely sure who will be next, but we have a much bigger goal for 2025 anyway: Story Mode! We are going to do EVERYTHING in our power to make sure that at least the first few Story Mode chapters are released by the end of next year. The script is nearing completion at this point (about 3/4 done), and once it's finalized, we'll waste no time getting to work on the mode itself.

From the very beginning, Duels of Fortune's story has been our top priority. So, while we'll try to keep up the usual pace of our playable character releases, know that they might end up taking a back seat for Story Mode when we're ready to work on it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/616cd48f4efc1ef78599fd66dfdb443703f28ecf.gif

And that's all we have to share for now! Hopefully this post has given you lots to look forward to for the end of the year and beyond! Duels of Fortune has been around for a painfully long time by now, but we can assure you that the real fun is just getting started! Have a happy holidays, Duelists! We'll see you next year!

- Ben and Kaleb

notes.title: NEW FIGHTER: Lance! Version 0.9.0 is Live!
notes.notes:
Lance Marshall joins the fight!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/ba6f125e4db91dd26f5e81b32195632769187a07.gif

Howdy, pardners! In this here Duels of Fortune update, saddle up to have a hollerin' good time playin' as the newest cowboy on the ranch...

No never mind I will not be writing the patch notes like that.

Anyway, yes, he's FINALLY here! The wild, gunslinging mercenary Lance Marshall joins the Duels of Fortune roster! Considering this character was first announced nearly 6 years ago (dear lord), he was LONG overdue to be added to the playable cast, and we couldn't be happier to see him in action after all this time!

For a quick overview: Lance is a mid-range zoning character who uses his arsenal of gun-based attacks to lock down the stage and keep the opponent at bay. Between ricochet shots with Deadeye, access to multiple types of guns with Golden Arsenal, and extra support with HE Grenade, Lance features one of the largest arrays of projectile attacks in the game!

The other major feature of this update is a moveset overhaul for Ember!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/b55fe1c263dc92327452db139dcc546b7011852b.gif

We've updated her Spin Attack special move to make it a core mobility tool for her, and we've added several new moves to help flesh out her existing kit! She's feeling like a brand-new slime! Note that some of her moves now have different inputs to accommodate the changes, but she certainly hasn't lost what made her fun before. She's just become much more rich and focused!

Aside from that, this version also adds the usual new costumes, new Missions, and a healthy dose of bug fixes, albeit much less of all three than usual. The characters were really the focus of this update!

Crumple

 Hitting an opponent who is in the crumple state with a move that normally keeps them standing (such as most Light attacks) will now launch them slightly, similar to how OTG hits work
 This is to prevent easy restands, especially with the new character Lance Fixed an issue where entering the Crumple state wouldn’t reset the afflicted player’s momentum

Combo Trials

Throw

 This move causes large spikes to emerge from the blob, knocking the opponent either away from Ember or towards her depending on which side of the spikes they are hit by. This gives Ember a brand-new option for how to use her active Blob, allowing her to mix up her options

 Ember’s teleport attack, which is now performed with a held Special input. Nothing about the move itself has been altered, though it does now properly have its own name. The animation has been adjusted so that it should have the same startup time as before, even while being a held input

Crash Landing (Neutral Super)

 The move can no longer be Blast Bursted while the ship is falling. This is to fix an issue where Blast Bursting as the ship collided with the ground would cause Ember to not enter the Burst animation

Luck of the Draw (Down Super)

notes.title: More Mission Mode Overhauls! Version 0.8.5 is Live!
notes.notes:
Heya, Duelists!

We've released another "between characters" update, this time focused primarily on improving the experience of playing through Mission Mode.

While we were fixing some bugs related to certain Missions, we decided on a whim to take the time to go through each Mission and evaluate their relative difficulty and overall quality, and we ended up tweaking a large number of Missions as a result. Some Missions have seen an increase in their challenge or complexity, others have had their more frustrating elements toned down, and others still have just been spiced up in some way to make them more fun and interesting!

Even though the list of changes is already INCREDIBLY long, we still didn’t quite have time to make all the additions and adjustments we wanted to. We’re hoping we’ll be able to fit in the rest of these changes in the next major update alongside the 20th playable fighter, Lance Marshall. While we can't 100% promise anything, said update is currently on track to release later this month!

Here are the full patch notes for this update:

[spoiler]Shade[/spoiler]

GOAL: Slow characters like Baron struggled extremely hard with this fight, as it was much harder (even outright impossible at times) for them to dodge certain attacks in the second phase. These changes should help ease that pain, and make the second phase feel a bit more fair in general.

 Reduced the knockback and hitstun of the uppercut attack, making it so you are no longer practically guaranteed to be rung out if hit by it
 Increased recovery time of the lunging grab attack, and made it so the move will always whiff if you are crouching
 Increased recovery time of the teleport Super
 If the boss gets rung out too many times, it will now have a chance to quickly teleport back onto the stage instead of slowly floating back, which can catch the player off-guard and prevent them from cheesing the fight by looping ringouts

[spoiler]The Pill[/spoiler]

GOAL: Don't worry, this boss is still stupid. It's just plain funny for a boss like this to be so absurdly difficult. However, there was some unintended behaviour with the boss that made it a bit more stupid than it was actually supposed to be, so that has now been corrected.

 Increased the window the player has to Throw Break the Pill’s throw
 Reduced the blockstun of all gunshot attacks
 Fixed an issue where a CPU-controlled [spoiler]The Pill[/spoiler] could use an anti-air shot to cancel its neutral getup, getup roll, or air recovery animations
 Fixed an issue where [spoiler]The Pill[/spoiler] could combo off its Break Burst
 In exchange, the Break Burst now deals damage

notes.title: A Grab Bag of New Content! Version 0.8.4 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hello Duelists!

We've released a pretty chunky update today, with lots of new content and some balance changes to both system mechanics and characters.

Some highlights of this update are:

 A new stage, Penny Avenue
 A new minigame, Target Training
 Changes to Reversals, air blocking, and aerial backdashes
 New costumes
 New Missions
 and lots of bug fixes!
The next big update will be 0.9.0, which will add the game's next playable fighter, Lance Marshall! His gun-slinging skills will take a good while longer to polish up, but in the meantime, we hope you enjoy this smaller update to tide you over!

Here are the full patch notes:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/72722acf000ed0f84a51de29038dcf201fccc853.png

New Music

 Added a new music track: Hit the Streets! (Preliminary Battle)

Reversals

 Changed all characters’ standing Reversals to have a minimum of 21 frames of startup (up from 14 frames). Characters who previously had longer Reversal startup still have startup longer than 21 frames. Boss characters' Reversals are untouched
 Added some additional VFX when using a Reversal
 Fixed an issue where dashing into a player using a Reversal would cause them to slide across the screen
 Fixed an issue where whiffing a Reversal after whiffing a Break Burst would briefly put your character into the air
 Fixed an issue where whiffing a Break Burst after landing a Reversal would cause your character to not enter the whiff recovery animation

Air Blocking

 If you block an attack in the air, blockstun now lasts approximately 25% longer compared to blocking an attack on the ground

Light Attacks

 Most characters have had the animation length of their light attacks reduced, making them recover faster than before. Specific changes are in each character section
 Light attacks now inflict greater blockstun against airborne opponents

Aerial Backdashes

 Aerial backdashes can now be cancelled with any air attack after 5 frames

Getup

 Fixed an issue where, after getting up from a knockdown state (either with a neutral getup or a roll), there was sometimes a single frame where you were unable to jump, leading to meaty grabs being unavoidable

Throw Break

 Fixed an issue where throw breaks could still be activated even if the throw was interrupted by other means

Burst

 Fixed an issue where Bursting during the crumple animation would cause you to be put into permanent hitstun the next time you were crumpled
 Visual effects of Bursts will now properly freeze during cinematics, instead of continuing to play
 Fixed an issue where Bursting during a throw tech would result in a Blast Burst
 Fixed an issue where the crumple limit would not be reset after landing a Blast Burst

Miscellaneous

 If any player’s controller disconnects mid-match, the game will now automatically pause with a warning telling you which controller disconnected. You do not have to reconnect the controller to continue, but one of the players has to manually unpause
 While the game is in focus, the mouse cursor will no longer remain visible on the game window if a controller is connected

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/e493e688709d6351430042a5c8ca79827148f724.png

NEW STAGE

 Added a new stage: Penny Avenue


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/cbb7716b618ef949dac8accd7cb34567d22cb15d.png

Lore Journal

 Added new NPC Lore entries
 Warrez Skyhawk, Joseph Underwood, and Joel Kazou are unlocked by playing 5 matches on Penny Avenue
 Vicky Ambrosia and Chef Mick Rowave are unlocked by playing 10 matches on Penny Avenue

Pause Menu

 The button assigned as the “Back” button for menu controls can now be used to unpause the game, in addition to the assigned “Start” button

Character Select Screen

 Fixed multiple sprite layering issues with the control rebinding menu on the character select screen

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/981c3af368d00472949c5d9875aca192d4820d44.png

Minigames

 Added a new minigame: Target Training! Break as many targets as you can before time runs out, with some targets requiring specific types of attacks to be broken!
 This minigame can appear in Arcade Mode, and can also be played on its own from the Minigames menu! Fixed an issue where projectiles were unable to hit objects in the Destruction minigame

Mission Mode

 Added a fourth page to Mission Mode. The following Missions have been moved to Page 4:

 Plague Be Upon Ye
 Snowday Showdown
 Reverse Horde 3
 Bullet Bounce Arena
 A Tough Pill to Swallow Added 4 new Missions, all to Page 3

 Royal Entertainment
 Animated Atrocity
 Buff Boi Bodyguard
 True Chivalrous Spirit The Mission "Giant Battle" now takes place on the Penny Avenue stage

Training Mode

 Made some changes to the Visible Hitboxes setting

 The hitboxes of projectile attacks are now properly displayed
 Hitboxes and hurtboxes are now fully rendered over the character models, making them much easier to see. Hitboxes (the boxes showing the zone in which attacks will land) are on a higher layer and will partially cover hurtboxes (the boxes showing where the character can get hit)
 Hitboxes with the “disjointed” property (meaning they do not count as part of the attacker’s hurtbox) are now coloured orange to distinguish them
 Rattlebone’s sword attack hitboxes when using Chivalrous Spirit are no longer coloured purple, as it was unnecessary, and would have overwritten the aforementioned disjoint colour, making it likely more confusing than helpful Made some changes to the Projectile Data setting

 Renamed to "Extra Data"
 Now has an additional box containing data on any special states the player character currently has (such as invincibility or armour), and whether or not an attack is disjointed. This should help newer players understand the properties of specific moves without having to ask what the changing hitbox/hurtbox colours mean

Boss Fights

 Fixed an issue where boss rematches would never trigger the victory screen, causing the matches to go on forever

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/6bacad961bbdbdf0a560c76a9f1d7bf1aeaacfb2.png

NEW COSTUME

 Added a new costume: Buff Boi Mascot Clyde

 To unlock, beat the new Mission "Buff Boi Bodyguard"

Standing Light

 Reduced total animation length ([strike]20f[/strike] → 19f)
 Reduced the amount of time the hitbox is active ([strike]10f[/strike] → 6f)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/292503c199498a831a5c10640f6ad61ffed217ab.png

notes.title: The Next Fighter: Yosei Kanji! - June 2024 Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Duelists!

We hope you've all been doing well! We've got a new status update post for you today, this time focusing heavily on what's new in the upcoming 0.8.0 update! So let's not waste any time and get right into it, starting with undoubtedly the biggest piece of news...

[hr][/hr]
The Tidal Assassin, Yosei Kanji

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/cf58fc17723ca8d86c0afe7e6b603736b5694265.png
Just earlier today, we officially revealed Duels of Fortune's 19th playable fighter: Yosei Kanji, a trained assassin with a mastery of the katana, and the estranged elder sister of Shoto. Wielding her blade, her powerful "Suijin" Aspect, and her two different stances, Yosei will be making some serious waves in the arena!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/d49ee05f4436ca10993c3e106006e1ab4f73d02f.gif

Yosei has the unique privilege of being able to switch her stance, effectively giving her two different movesets in one! Each stance has its own strengths and weaknesses, but there is also some special interplay between the two, encouraging you to constantly switch it up! Yosei always starts the battle in Iaido style, a defensive stance in which she wields precise, long-ranged attacks, but has limited damage output and offensive capabilities. She can keep the opponent away, and can maybe put on the pressure if needed, but has trouble capitalizing on it. By using her Down Special, however, you can switch to Tsunami style, where Yosei's offense really shines! Tsunami style lets you go wild, crushing the opponent's defenses and comboing to your heart's content, dealing some serious damage in the process! You even gain access to a strong projectile which travels along the ground, letting you control the opponent's position more easily.

So what's the catch? All your command normals and Special Moves in Tsunami style drain your HP. All the water she uses with her Aspect has to come from somewhere, and it turns out that a part of it is the water in her own body. You'll have to be very careful with how you use this stance so as not to damage yourself more than you're damaging the opponent... OR you can gather some helpful Koi Spirits to prevent that self-damage in the first place! You'll gain a Koi Spirit if you hit the opponent with the VERY tip of your Focus Slash attack in Iaido style, and they'll activate automatically when you use a self-damaging move in Tsunami style, immediately giving back the HP you lost. These Koi Spirits have some other uses too (one of which may or may not involve a giant dragon), but we'll wait until Yosei's official Character Showcase to talk more about that! This section's already pretty long as is!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/2e9353b5fe713b01d7b4fb50436bc72c99457c0f.gif

Regardless, we hope you look forward to playing as Yosei when she crashes in this July! We'll announce an exact release date once we're more confident we can provide one.

There's more to look forward to in the Yosei update as well, including a new mechanic that's been requested by the community for some time...

[hr][/hr]
Projectile Clashing

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/24cea1275d46b79fa3188004296bb6557b76b8af.gif

For as long as Duels of Fortune has existed, opposing projectiles have always simply passed through each other... until now! In the 0.8.0 update, projectiles will now collide with each other in various ways, depending on the priority value of the two projectiles. In general, projectiles of the same priority will clash, destroying each other, while projectiles with higher priority will beat the lower ones clean! There's other factors involved, such as the fact that projectiles that hit multiple times will always win in clash scenarios, but this is the basic idea!

This has opened up a lot of interesting new strategies for certain characters, letting them counter projectiles in ways they couldn't before! Callowman, for instance, has the rock from his Crouching Heavy, which now beats pretty much any projectile that doesn't come from a Super Move! And Johnson's Down Super, in which he throws his buddy Shaz, has the highest projectile priority in the game! It even beats out other Supers, giving him a surefire way to stop a projectile-happy opponent!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/30d2ece75043055b8703d443ec42cfd108f3ba62.gif

There's still some kinks to iron out with this system, but we still have plenty of time to do so before the update's release, so don't worry!

[hr][/hr]
New Costumes!

With us, a new update almost always means new costumes, and this one is no exception! With the summer season rolling in, some of our fighters have been finding their own ways to beat the heat!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/5d053d48fd8227b4e61cfc68777c91769757844a.png
Beachwear Clyde and Shark Prank Black Heart will be rolling in for the 0.8.0 update, and a third summer-themed costume is on the way too! We'll announce it over on our Twitter/X account  when it's ready, so make sure to follow us over there to see what we're cooking!

The summer costumes aren't the only ones, either! With this update introducing a new member of the Kanji family, it's only right that Shoto gets a costume for the occasion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/e844ddd7173e450c56a202c948f5e9bb0986d943.png
Thunder God Shoto is quite the striking sight, but given his so-called "Raijin" Aspect, it's certainly a look that lives up to the name!

[hr][/hr]
So What's Next?
The grind doesn't stop after the Yosei update releases in July, as we'll be setting our sights straight onto the next fighter! Who will that be? Well, how about we do you four better and show you our plans for the next FIVE fighters!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/328494e88d82282467ba386a7e775b732c2e3cf4.png
While our favourite gunslinger Lance was already very likely to be the next fighter after Yosei, his victory in the popularity poll as the "Most Anticipated Upcoming Fighter" cemented his spot. Being one of the oldest known characters planned for the Duels of Fortune roster, first revealed all the way back in 2018 (before even now-foundational characters like Annie and Sylvan!), it's about time we finally brought him into the game proper!

After that, we'll be working on a secret mystery fighter, followed by our third guest character! We're very excited for both of these, and we hope you guys will be excited to see them when they're ready! And finally, for the furthest-out of the bunch, it'll be the duo fighter Miko Starfinder, then yet another mystery fighter! To be honest, we're still deciding between a couple candidates for that last slot, so even we don't know exactly what to expect yet! But whoever it is, we'll of course make sure they're a worthwhile addition to the cast!

We're not ready to give release windows for any of these upcoming characters just yet (we've been bitten by that before!), but we're at least hoping to have Lance and the fighter after him both done by the end of the year!

notes.title: "Where's Azutron?" - April 2024 Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Duelists!

We hope you're all still enjoying Duels of Fortune, especially after the massive balance & polish update that was released a little over a month ago! We think the game's been feeling a lot better since then!

Recently, we've realized we may have a bit of an unintentional communication problem. While we do speak very actively with the community on our official Discord server, both about DoF and about other random topics, we failed to realize just how many of our fans lie outside of that Discord community! As such, we're going to make an effort from now on to keep all of you much more updated on DoF's development with these Steam news posts, perhaps using them as monthly devlogs of sorts. We want to make sure no one is left out of the loop for too long!

That being said, let's not waste any more time, and get into the topics we want to focus on today. Starting with the most important question...

[hr][/hr]
Where's Azutron?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/952cef12e872d2810f275322168be4f5a344bf50.gif

As many of you may know, our next character, Azutron S-Type, is currently in development. However, he was originally scheduled for release in late February, and it's April now, so... what gives?

We won't beat around the bush here -- development has been a lot slower than we'd like. Not only do we now both have jobs outside of game development (whereas previously only one of the two of us did), but the aforementioned balance patch took also a lot longer than we expected, which pushed back Azutron's development significantly.

That being said, he's relatively close to being done now! Currently, we're predicting Azutron to release before the end of April, but of course any number of unexpected factors could still delay it further. We'll do everything in our power to stick to this window, though!

It's also worth mentioning that Azutron hasn't been the only thing taking up our dev time lately, as the scope of the 0.7.0 update has increased a decent bit beyond just adding him. But hey, at least that gives us some exciting new things to show off in this post! Let's start with one you may have already heard about...

[hr][/hr]
He's Got a Gun?!

[previewyoutube=6v74IVMDGuw;full][/previewyoutube]
For our April Fools announcement this year, we unveiled a "brand-new character" in Callowman With a Gun!

While this altered version of Callowman isn't actually being added to the roster proper, he'll still be featured in the game as a special Mission Mode opponent. After beating him, however, you WILL actually unlock the ability to play as him, as long as you have Boss Mode enabled! Just hold Start while selecting Callowman, and you'll get to wield all that ungodly power for yourself!

[hr][/hr]
New Stage: Sylvan's Office!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/7d5a41aa68684868489d15c956a32c83e0dd5b9c.png
Every narcissistic, larger-than-life billionaire needs an equally larger-than-life work suite, and the new Sylvan's Office stage shows just how luxuriously the sleazy gambling tycoon likes to spend his "working" hours.

As you can see by all the gold trimming and tacky art pieces, Sylvan really spares no expense... on himself, anyway. Keen-eyed players may even be able to spot some hidden details among the display shelves in the back!

[hr][/hr]
New Boss Battle: Azutron T-Type!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/c1cc015c19202ccbc150baeb114dd1382b8cb393.png
As the powerful, interdimensional militaristic force they are, the Azu-Corps naturally must have some heavy artillery, and the Azutron T-Type, A.K.A. "Gigatron", is exactly that!

Players who dare to face this gargantuan foe will have to contend with an onslaught of hard-hitting attacks, trapping projectiles, and a shielding system that prevents Gigatron from being flinched or launched until you deal enough damage! As the "T-" in his designation implies, he's an absolute tank, and you'll need to use both heavy offense and extreme caution if you want to take him down!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/11e7e464ec50f8f4f4aa8a777c05fee60dbdb3f3.gif

The Gigatron fight will take the form of a new Boss Mission in Mission Mode! Good luck to all challengers!

[hr][/hr]
And Finally... A Character Popularity Poll!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/dcd0098424488951ccfc5da425b381e88b3fd96e.png

With Duels of Fortune having been available on Steam for a good few months (and well over a YEAR on smaller storefronts!), it feels long overdue for us to hold our first-ever character popularity poll!

Who do you like playing the most? Have a soft spot for a particular character's personality or lore? Maybe you even have a favourite background character! Well now's your chance to finally tell us all of that and more! This character poll is all-encompassing, including categories about way more than just the playable cast! While any question about non-playable characters is optional, we'd highly encourage you to try to answer them all anyway, as we're very curious about who the most beloved in each category will be!

Link to the full form: Click here!

With Story Mode not being out yet, we're very interested to see people's opinions based on just the brief lore and interactions that are currently in the game! Voting will only be open until April 14, 2024, so don't miss your chance!

[hr][/hr]
Wrapping Up
And that covers everything we wanted to talk about in this post! As mentioned before, we'll be making an effort to release posts like this on a more regular basis now. Even if we don't have much to talk about in a given month, we'll still do our best to keep you all updated on our current activities!

With that, we wish you a great day, and we hope you're looking forward to all the exciting new content coming in the Azutron update! See you around!

- Ben and Kaleb

notes.notes:
Happy Holidays, Duelists!

This small, semi-holiday-themed content update adds a handful of new costumes and Missions, fixes quite a few bugs, and adds the previously Mission-exclusive Cube City stage to the stage select!

Also, to quickly answer a question many players new to the Steam release have understandably been asking: No, Duels of Fortune will sadly not be getting online play. We would honestly love to, but it's just not possible. This is mainly because we were very clueless when we first started making the game (not surprising considering we were both still in high school), and the old framework that the game is built on simply is not compatible with online. Without getting into technical talk, the game would desync a LOT, and there'd be nothing we could do about. The only way to add online would be to essentially restart development from scratch; a monumental task that we -- a team of just two people with an extremely low budget -- are not willing to undertake. If we had to do that, we'd rather just make a new game.

TL;DR: Duels of Fortune will not have online play because this game is built on spaghetti code and a dream. Sorry about that. We hope our bigger focus on singleplayer content will make up for it!

notes.title: Post-Release Status Update, and Our Current Plans For 2024
notes.notes:
Hello, Duelists! 

Whether you've been with us for years, or you're brand-new to the community, we hope you've been enjoying your time with Duels of Fortune so far! It's warmed our silly little hearts to see so much love for the game and to see so many new people picking it up for the first time! We seriously appreciate everyone who's taken the time to play, share, or review the game, it means a lot to us!

We'd like to take this opportunity to provide you all with an update on what the two of us devs are currently doing, and what we plan to be doing over the course of the next year. This'll be a bit of a chunky read, so you might wanna get comfortable! And just be aware that anything we say here is subject to change.

Also, as a quick note, we have an official Discord server where we often talk about our short-term and long-term plans for the game, so if you want to be the first to know about said plans going forward, be sure to join up! It's a super chill place with lots of great people, and we're very casual with our community over there, so don't be afraid to say hi!

Now then, onto the important stuff!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Crimbo 2023 Update!
Right around the corner is our yearly Crimbo Update! This is a small content update we do every December, which typically includes a few new wintery or holiday-themed costumes! This year is, of course, no exception!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/d8e0e6236d4de5adb6399d7ba3b2ea00bf772d51.png Tomatoes may not be in season, but Ember sure looks cozy in those PJ's!

This year's winter costume lineup will consist of the frosty Snow Callowman, the comfy Tomato Ember, and a third costume we'll reveal at a later date!

The Crimbo Update should ideally release right around Christmas, and will also include fixes for some of the bugs reported since the Steam release!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

New Fighters!
Naturally, we plan to add plenty of new playable fighters to the roster throughout next year! While the order is largely undecided as of right now, here's a little teaser of at least the next two!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/7bdc4db6037fcc8877a44ad08fd70447ab8e3dbd.png
AZUTRON S-TYPE
A speedy pixie character who can position himself practically anywhere in the blink of an eye, Azutron's highly versatile skillset can keep opponents on their toes nonstop! He's one of the many robots of his kind that make up the interdimensional military police force known as the Azu-Corps.

 A lightning-fast fighter whose Special moves all aid his movement in some way, including an insane 8-way teleport!
 Rush your opponent down and create deadly mixups, or kite them with your speed and punish their every mistake! Azutron's crazy mobility opens up tons of options!
 Keep an eye on your overheat meter! Get too carried away with your teleport and other movement tools, and it might blow up in your face, literally!

Azutron will be the next fighter added to the game, and he should be on track for a February 2024 release!

"SAMURAI"
Sorry, but we're keeping details about this mysterious fighter under wraps for now (yes, even their name)! What we can say, though, is that they'll be very important to the story of a certain electricity-wielding karate student...

You can likely expect this character sometime in Q2 2024!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Story Mode!
In the year 2014, nearly the entire population of Earth possesses unique, super-powered abilities known as Aspects. Thanks to those wanting to show off the power of their Aspects, and to watch other people's Aspects in action, fighting tournaments have risen in popularity more than ever. And this year, the single biggest tournament ever held is about to take place: the Duels of Fortune!

With most of the pieces now in place, 2024 will be the year we FINALLY start working on Duels of Fortune's Story Mode!

Once we finish writing the script and developing the cutscene system (both of which are already work-in-progress), we intend to start off with the prologue and first 2 chapters, and release those all at once. After that, we'd ideally like to release chapters in similar batches alongside new characters, though we're currently not sure how feasible that is.

Regardless, this is a story we've been gradually cooking up for over 5 years now, and we couldn't be more excited to finally begin to tell it! We currently have no solid estimate of when the first batch of Story Mode chapters will release, but we'll give an update later on when we're more confident!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Rolling Rampage!
Hey wait, this isn't DoF! What gives?

Well, for those unaware, we've been taking a short break from working on Duels of Fortune over the past couple months. During this time, we've instead dedicated ourselves to learning the Godot engine, and Rolling Rampage is the result of that! It's a small endless-runner-style game (though not at all endless, in our case) where you play as a spherical alien named Zorb, tearing up the streets and causing as much mayhem as possible!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44768017/962d7ce326e86d89a8a22337b90c99826f833d3f.gif
You might recognize Zorb, as he was featured as one of DoF's Mission mode bosses!

We're planning to wrap up this project very soon, releasing it on itch.io sometime around the new year! We had originally planned to start another small project after this, but we've instead decided we'll be going back to full-focusing Duels of Fortune for the time being!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Well, that about covers everything we wanted to share! Aside from the Crimbo update, we plan to take it easy for the rest of this year, but in 2024 we're ready to dive straight back into Duels of Fortune with FULL FORCE!!

Once again, thanks a ton for all the support you've given us, and we hope you look forward to the exciting additions to come!

Enjoy your holidays, and have a happy new year!
- Ben and Kaleb
